Journey

QUINNDOM · ROAD PROTOTYPE

Arrow keys or A/D to run, Space or W to jump. Stomp little creatures from above. Hit ? blocks from below. Armies and mini-bosses fight automatically: the flag over their heads shows your odds. The tent heals the army once a day.

How Journey works

World map. Five regions, five levels. Finish a level to unlock the next one. Each region ends at a castle guarded by a big boss.

Levels. Run and jump like a platformer. Stomp little creatures for coins. Hit ? blocks from below: they hold coins, Mimosa (+1 hint in your next boss puzzle) and Psilocybe (heals part of the army).

Army health. The army is your heroes' health. Armies and mini-bosses fight automatically and cost health. When it runs out, the army falls back to the last checkpoint with a little health. The tent heals it once a day.

Bosses. Each castle boss challenges you to one of the five puzzles (Wxrdie, El Mundo, Kuduso, Mapnitude, Zame). Win to clear the level. Nothing is ever lost.
